blocks.text: Metro Manila-based SUD is set to mark a major milestone in their musical journey with their first major concert, happening on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at Samsung Hall, SM Aura, Taguig City as a thank-you to everyone who has been part of their journey. Celebrating fifteen years of music, This Is How We Play: 15 Years Of SUD brings together the songs and stories that have shaped the band’s career. The anniversary concert produced by Minsan Studio offers an opportunity to revisit and reimagine the music that has accompanied SUD and their listeners through different chapters of their lives, while celebrating […]...
